next.reason: 1985 permits giving 'selected table elements' values with VALUE clauses; by 1985 VI.5.15.6 GR6 a VALUE on an OCCURS entry or its subordinates sets every occurrence. 2023 keeps that: such a VALUE clause 'causes every occurrence of the associated data item to be assigned the specified value' (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR9), and adds the table-format VALUE, whose entry has an OCCURS (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR18) and whose FROM subscripts pick the element (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR20): 'The table element initialized is identified by subscript-1' (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR12). The permission is unchanged for a 1985 program.
